- Aon partnered with a fuel card distributor to reach SME hauliers, proving distribution viability. Nirvana should evaluate similar fuel card or telematics partnerships to acquire SME delivery fleets [2].
- The US MGA market is shifting toward underwriting discipline and profitability amid pricing pressure. This reinforces the need for Nirvana's strict telematics-based risk selection as capacity tightens [4].
- Amazon warned New York City shoppers of higher delivery costs due to a proposed driver employment bill. Nirvana must monitor employment classification legislation affecting DSP operating models and risk [1].
- Uber secured roughly 87% of Delivery Hero shares, consolidating global logistics. Nirvana should watch how major platform consolidation impacts commercial fleet scale and insurance requirements [3].
